sceneMounting.note: the twin places the root at (0, 0, waterRailZ); gantry.x = gantryX, trolley.z = trolleyZ - waterRailZ, hoist.y = hoistY

lodNaming.note: every node under LODn carries the suffix; twist-locks exist in LOD0 only

gantry.note: unbounded along the quay rail in the twin; this range is for the asset viewer

trolley.note: from the waterside rail; 68 m outreach [V], 18 m backreach behind the landside rail [A]

hoist.note: spreader underside height above the rail: 52 m lift [V]; 20 m below the rail into the hold [A]

twin_locks.note: lowered = twin-20 lift (inner castings of two 20 ft boxes)

stretch.note: ropes.scale.y = ropes.y - (hoist.y + offsetM), both children of the trolley

LOD0.note: camera to crane centre; the renderer adds 15 % hysteresis

branding.placement: machinery house sides (blue on white), main girder outer faces (white on blue)

craneNumbers.placement: seaward and landward portal beams, landside end of the machinery house
craneNumbers.uvConvention: TEXCOORD_0 of material sts_plate is authored for tile 0 (crane 101); add (index % cols, floor(index / cols)) * tileSizeUv

provenance.fact: 52 m lift height above rail (hoist travel maximum)
68 m seaward outreach from the waterside rail (trolley travel minimum)

provenance.reason: builder version: real fleet is 5 Malaccamax + 3 Super Post-Panamax

provenance.fact: dark royal-blue steelwork, white machinery house, yellow spreader, lattice boom, ties, ladders, catwalks, floodlights
apex, trolley-rail and hinge heights, leg spacing, backreach, bogie layout, house size
ZPMC wordmark set in Archivo ExtraBold; crane numbers 101-124 on plates

provenance.reason: spec: manufacturer wordmark and crane numbers only, no operator branding

provenance.fact: forestays rotate with the boom (they detach from the apex when the boom is raised)
provenance.reason: boom raising is a viewer-only pose; real tie bars fold

provenance.fact: ladder cages, handrail posts and festoon loops simplified
